sources.title: LTFRB Traditional PUJ Provisional Fare Increase General Fare Guide
sources.publisher: Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board
sources.verification_method: Read the official fare guide; no current Cebu route-specific confirmation found.
sources.notes: Historical general traditional-PUJ fare evidence: PHP 13.00 for the first four kilometres and PHP 1.80 per succeeding kilometre. Stored as STALE evidence and never used for a current journey fare.

sources.title: LTFRB temporary PUJ fare guide and validity, reported 2026-09-28
sources.publisher: Philippine News Agency, reporting LTFRB rates
sources.verification_method: Reviewed the Philippine News Agency report of the LTFRB rate announcement and temporary matrix validity; no current Cebu route-specific fare matrix was found.
sources.notes: PNA reports LTFRB traditional-PUJ rates of PHP 14 for the first 4 km and PHP 2 per succeeding kilometre, effective 2026-09-28, and that the temporary fare guide is valid through 2026-12-31. Rate announcement: https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1284951. Government broadcaster PTV reports regular and discounted rates: https://ptvnews.ph/ltfrb-releases-new-matrices-for-puv-fare-hikes-effective-sept-28/. PIA corroboration: https://pia.gov.ph/news/luzon/car/fare-hike-eases-puj-drivers-rising-operating-costs-in-benguet/. These do not establish a Cebu route-specific tariff or Biyahe fare-distance basis.

sources.title: LTFRB 2026 PUV fare guides, including traditional PUJ discounts
sources.verification_method: Reviewed PTV's report of the LTFRB fare guide; no Cebu route-specific fare matrix or fare-distance basis was found.
sources.notes: Reports traditional PUJ regular fare and student/elderly/PWD discount rates effective 2026-09-28. Treat as government reporting rather than a directly inspected fare matrix. The temporary guide expiry is separately recorded from PNA.
